# EGAD50000000011

```{r}
if (file.exists("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D.gt")) {
  NEO_E_TC_A <- gt_load("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D.gt")
} else {
  NEO_E_TC_A <- gen_tibble("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A.bed", allow_duplicates = TRUE, quiet = TRUE, valid_alleles = c("T", "G", "A", "C", "I", "D"))
  nrow(NEO_E_TC_A) # 41
count_loci(NEO_E_TC_A) # 2221421
NEO_E_TC_A <- NEO_E_TC_A %>% select_loci(-all_of(c(which(show_loci(NEO_E_TC_A)$allele_ref %in% c("I", "D")))))
count_loci(NEO_E_TC_A)
double_NA_NEO_E_TC_A <- which(is.na(show_loci(NEO_E_TC_A)$allele_ref) & is.na(show_loci(NEO_E_TC_A)$allele_alt))
NEO_E_TC_A <- NEO_E_TC_A %>% select_loci(-all_of(double_NA_NEO_E_TC_A))
count_loci(NEO_E_TC_A)
table(NEO_E_TC_A$population)
dups <- NEO_E_TC_A %>% find_duplicated_loci()
NEO_E_TC_A <- NEO_E_TC_A %>% select_loci(-all_of(dups))

if (file.exists("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D.bk")) {
  file.remove("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D.bk")
  file.remove("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D.rds")
  file.remove("../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D.gt")
}

NEO_E_TC_A <- gt_update_backingfile(NEO_E_TC_A,
  backingfile = "../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D"
)

gt_save(NEO_E_TC_A, file_name = "../data/raw/data_input/ega-box-1667_Raw_AfricanNeo_E__TC-2508_200401_A_no_I_D")

}

```

# Merge NEO_E

```{r}
if (file.exists("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_E_TC_A_B.gt")) {
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_E_TC_A_B.gt")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_E_TC_A_B.bk")
  file.remove("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_E_TC_A_B.rds")
}
```

```{r}
NEO_E <- rbind(NEO_E_TC_A, NEO_E_TC_B,
  as_is = FALSE, flip_strand = TRUE, use_position = FALSE,
  quiet = TRUE, backingfile = "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/NEO_E_TC_A_B"
)
```

```{r}
rm(NEO_E_TC_A, NEO_E_TC_B, NEO_E)
gc()
```
